name: Pristine Fossil
description: More Life modifiers (10x weight); blocks Armour, Evasion, and Energy Shield modifiers entirely.

name: Metallic Fossil
description: More Lightning damage and resistance modifiers (10x weight); blocks Physical modifiers entirely.

name: Scorched Fossil
description: More Fire damage and resistance modifiers (10x weight); blocks Cold modifiers entirely.

name: Frigid Fossil
description: More Cold damage and resistance modifiers (10x weight); blocks Fire modifiers entirely.

name: Dense Fossil
description: More Armour, Evasion, and Energy Shield modifiers (10x weight); blocks Life modifiers entirely.

name: Corroded Fossil
description: Blocks Elemental modifiers (Fire, Cold, Lightning); enhances Chaos and Physical crafts.

name: Sanctified Fossil
description: Modifiers roll higher tiers more frequently; suppresses low tier rolls.
